title: Integrate the European text reader callback registry
changes: Add an E169-d168 typed resource for the conditional 27-word text-reader callback registry and its two original literals, preserving guest dispatch and out-of-projection reads.
validation: Protected static source audit mj5buj5x and Windows test build 5ec8jzgg pass. First build 45i6ch28 failed on a missing Bus trait import in the test; it was corrected.

Wine j15jcf44 creates/reuses/verifies E169, preserves all 111 E168 resources, rejects modified callback and partial overlap, and checks mixed-width adjacent-owner reads with source ROM bytes altered. Twelve controlled original interpreter prefixes match complete state and guest clock, including out-of-projection index 27. Wine server drained.

Windows GNU production CLI build 1sppxxpd and Wine mr5vn2od pass create/reuse/verify with all 113 files matching the tested E169 generation. A recorded 1800-frame home continuation reads 28 managed registry callback bytes and matches raw/managed framebuffer and OAM each frame plus final state and framebuffer hashes. Wine drained.
limitations: The scene compares no audio and does not poison source ROM; the controlled test covers altered source bytes. Registry counters are aggregate, and native dispatch can fall back to interpretation. Other scenes, translated-prefix attribution, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
